answer: Copying the same citations across 131 aliases therefore burns the reading cost 131 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the island check immediately, the hollow audit keeps the resolved set and the falcon replay makes public exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
